hypotheses.evidence_standard: Policy-stage claims can be corroborated on-chain (proxy slot values, resolved authorities, sibling artifacts) — strongest possible provenance for cross-contract and proxy-context claims.
hypotheses.hard_case_results: Steelman verified: the policy stage ALREADY holds sibling effects artifacts + controller_values (policy_worker.py:731-813) and proxy rows — the existing cross-contract enrichment is H4's mechanism with a broken rule (propagate EVERY label: cross_contract.py:29-35,168 — measured contagion: Teller.deposit inherits WETH9.deposit's hook_update mislabel; per-deployment nondeterminism on updateExchangeRate). Typed H4 derivations that static provably cannot make: (1) configures-transfer-policy-of(vault): Teller.allowFrom writes fromDenyList; BoringVault.hook controller_value == Teller address; Teller.beforeTransfer membership leaves read fromDenyList — all three artifacts exist at policy time (verified in my local artifacts + controller_values shape); (2) implementation_update provenance upgrade: classifier-confirmed 1967 slot + live proxy linkage; (3) registry-stored cross-contract pause. FULL relocation fails the battery differently: policy sees serialized artifacts, not IR — it cannot re-derive member-level writes, write polarity, modifier-origin, or interface-clobber corrections; and the ordering fact (core.py:206-241) shows trees+PauseInfo are already in scope at static labeling time, so relocation buys single-contract claims nothing.
hypotheses.corpus_impact_numbers: The propagate-all rule accounts for the cross-contract share of prod's 340 hook rows (deposit(ERC20,…) class ×10+ deployments) and the deployment-inconsistency class; a typed replacement eliminates both while ADDING the Teller→vault policy claim (12 Teller deployments in prod would gain a true cross-contract claim).
hypotheses.consumer_fit: Same consumers, later producer; but latency/race costs are real (memory: event-index cold races required a deferred reconciler) — single-contract labels would become dependent on policy-stage completion for no accuracy gain.
hypotheses.failure_modes: Full relocation couples chip text to resolution freshness; artifact-only view loses IR fidelity; blind propagation (the current H4-shaped code) is the single worst contagion mechanism measured.
hypotheses.verdict: PARTIAL WIN: adopt as the CROSS-CONTRACT + on-chain-corroboration layer (replace propagate-all with typed derivations); reject full relocation.

novel_hypotheses.summary: Split the system into a hardened FACTS plane and a registry-governed CLAIMS plane. Facts plane = EffectInfo upgraded: sink.origin ∈ {body, guard} (modifier-reached auth reads stop counting as effects — fixes the Teller.pause/auth.canCall dilution), member-level state writes (var, member_path), constant/view write-attribution exclusions (kills the OZv5 owner() row), interface-clobber fix in build_effects keying (fixes EigenLayer blanking), native Transfer/Send ops as value sinks. Claims plane = the effect-label vocabulary reborn as typed claims: each emission is {label, tier, witness} where witness is machine-checkable (leaf path into predicate_trees / canonical selector+event / sink id / slot value). Claims are produced at exactly TWO sites chosen by evidence locality: static (single-contract evidence: trees, PauseInfo, selectors, sinks) and policy (cross-contract/on-chain evidence: sibling artifacts, controller_values, classifier). A claim REGISTRY (code, not docs) declares every label's claim-sentence, allowed tiers, and witness schema; emitting outside the registry is unrepresentable. Consumers read the claims plane through one shared vocabulary module.
novel_hypotheses.evidence_standard: Every emitted semantic statement carries a witness a test can replay: tree-tier claims point at the exact leaf; selector-tier claims point at the selector+corroborating marker/event; structural-tier claims point at sink ids; policy-tier claims point at (sibling artifact id, controller_value, slot read). No witness kind exists for 'looks like' — the guess tier is not schema-representable.
novel_hypotheses.hard_case_results: Identical to H1 on the single-contract battery (it IS H1's derivations under the registry) plus the H4 cross-contract cases: Teller→vault transfer-policy claim, registry-pause, proxy-verified implementation provenance. The facts-plane fixes additionally repair cases NO label hypothesis touches: EigenLayer pause blanking, guard-sink dilution (858-row external_contract_call class), OZv5 view rows.
novel_hypotheses.consumer_fit: Consumers keep today's vocabulary and gain tier for display/weighting (protocolScore can discount structural vs tree-proven; PermissionsTab/graph.js chips can show provenance). Verified zero-regression paths: lane membership (same label ids), principal tags (same admin set minus hook_update — measured zero prod dependency), co-controller significance (unchanged set + implementation_update gain).
novel_hypotheses.failure_modes: Registry discipline can be bypassed by committing to the registry itself — countered by the corpus A/B gate (any label-diff on the frozen fixture corpus must be attached to the PR); witness replay costs CI time (bounded: 21-contract fixture corpus ≈ 6 min serial, parallelizable).
novel_hypotheses.verdict: ADOPT — it is H1's measured derivations + H2's facts-integrity principle + H3's mechanism-granular standards tier + H4's scoped cross-contract layer, under one structural governance mechanism.

novel_hypotheses.summary: Retire effect labels; drive lanes/chips/score directly from capability_expr + sinks (the authority pipeline's highest-trust outputs).
novel_hypotheses.evidence_standard: capability_expr is resolution-verified (finite_set/conditional_universal/cofinite) — the strongest artifact in the system — but it answers WHO can call, not WHAT the function does.
novel_hypotheses.hard_case_results: Category error on the battery: BoringVault.manage and Teller.deposit can share identical capability shape (requiresAuth) while being arbitrary-execution vs user deposit; WETH9.withdraw is public (conditional_universal) and so is approve — capability cannot separate 'moves value out' from 'sets allowance'. novel_hypotheses.consumer_fit: Starves compactActionSummary/tone entirely; classifyAction's kind axis has no input.
novel_hypotheses.failure_modes: Conflates authorization with effect; would push effect semantics back into name hints.
novel_hypotheses.verdict: REJECT; keep capability_expr as the authorization axis it already is.

evidenceFirst.recommended_design:
THE TWO-PLANE CLAIMS ARCHITECTURE (H5 = H1-derivations + H4-scoped-cross-contract + facts hardening + registry governance).

WHAT A LABEL IS: a typed claim `{label, tier, witness}` about a function's effect, where the claim sentence is fixed in a code registry and the witness is a machine-replayable pointer into the facts plane or the trees. A label without a registered evidence spec cannot be constructed (schema-level, not convention).

PLANE 1 — FACTS (services/static/…/effects.py, hardened): (a) SinkRecord gains origin ∈ {body, guard}: sinks reached only through modifier bodies are guard-origin (fixes auth.canCall-as-effect; verified mechanism on Teller 0x417e1ef6); (b) build_effects keys records by (full_name, has_body) preferring concrete over 0-node interface declarations (fixes the EigenLayer StrategyManager 0x88582996 blanking); (c) state-write facts add member-level pairs (var, member_path) from IR Member+Assignment (prototyped — distinguishes accountantState.isPaused from accountantState.payoutAddress); (d) write-attribution excludes is_constant vars and view functions (kills the OZ v5 OwnableStorageLocation false writes on L1SyncPoolETH 0x39272ee1); (e) native .transfer()/.send() IR ops become value sinks; (f) selector→direction corrected when from == address(this) (fixes recoverERC721).

PLANE 2 — CLAIMS, produced at two sites by evidence locality:
STATIC-SITE CLAIMS (all available pre-effects per core.py:206-241):
• pause_toggle — claim: "toggles a flag that blocks/unblocks other functions of this contract". Evidence (tree tier): PauseInfo derivation with four fixes, each verified on a real failure: _lookup_state_var → _all_state_variables (EtherFiNodesManager _paused, EigenLayer _paused); member-level extension using facts (c) + tree member_path operands with bool member type (Accountant isPaused in-struct; payoutAddress FP excluded by type); writer polarity/bool gate (excludes LiquidityPool.validatorSizeWei uint config); one_shot-leaf writers excluded (kills the 31-row initialize class + OneSig.setExecutorRequired). PauseAnalyzer's auth-gated-writer + revert-read-elsewhere requirements stay (they are what beat the old detector on Teller).
• ownership_transfer — claim: "rotates the scalar that authorizes callers as owner". Tree tier: caller_authority equality leaves referencing msg.sender; harvested vars must be scalar address-typed, non-constant (via _all_state_variables); writers must be state-changing non-views. Selector+event tier: 0xf2fde38b/0x715018a6 + OwnershipTransferred emission (carries OZ v5 + Solady where write attribution fails — verified recovering TopUp 0x5bdd4b0d).
• authorized_caller_update (NEW, split from ownership_transfer) — claim: "rotates a non-owner scalar that authorizes callers of specific functions" (chip: "changes controller"). Same tree evidence, var ∉ canonical-owner set (owner/_owner/OZ-v5 slot alias). Covers updatePauser/updateBlacklister/updateMasterMinter/updateRescuer (USDC 0x43506849, StakedTokenV1 0x31724ca0), setL1SyncPool/setMessenger family — ends the false "Transfers contract ownership" sentence on 26+ prod rows while keeping their admin-severity for consumers (added to the _admin set and CONTROL_EFFECTS).
• implementation_update — claim: "changes which code executes behind this deployment". Structural tier: fallback-reads-written-var (kept) + assembly matcher rewritten to compare RESOLVED SLOT VALUES not IR temp names (fixes FiatTokenProxy 0xa0b86991); selector+marker tier: 0x3659cfe6/0x4f1ef286 + (UUPS/ERC1967 inheritance ∨ proxiableUUID() ∨ Upgraded event) — verified recovering all 10 local UUPS rows; suppresses the redundant delegatecall_execution emphasis on the same fn. proxy_admin_update (NEW): changeAdmin 0x8f283970 + AdminChanged event.
• role_management / authority_update — unchanged canonical selectors (already correct; composeQueue negative pinned as fixture).
• timelock_operation — RESURRECTED via selector tier: TimelockController family (schedule/scheduleBatch/execute/executeBatch/cancel/updateDelay) gated on hashOperation+AccessControl markers (EtherFiTimelock 0x9f26d4c9 becomes fully labeled; the frontend branches at lane.js:36/:63 and protocolScore.js:177 stop being dead).
• arbitrary_external_call — RESURRECTED via structural tier: body-origin external-call sink whose destination AND calldata are parameter-tainted (BoringVault.manage, OneSig.executeTransaction, Timelock.execute/executeBatch) — the label consumers already treat as manager-grade (0.95 severity, _manager tag) finally gets producers.
• hook_update — NARROWED claim: "changes a code pointer that a value-moving function of this contract calls at runtime". Use-link evidence only (writes X; sibling body-origin-calls X and has value/mapping-write sinks), matching on IR destination identity instead of dest:{name} strings. The unclassified-pointer fallback is DELETED (measured: 53/54 of its emissions wrong); un-evidenced setters fall to fact-text ("Writes or calls into: X" — _action_summary :845 already renders this).
• asset_send/asset_pull/mint/burn — selector facts + facts-plane fixes (e)/(f) + local supply-write tier (is_erc20 ∧ writes totalSupply ∧ IR sign) recovering DAI/BoringVault/USDC/BackingEigen mint/burn.
• external_contract_call — DEMOTED to fact-tier: emitted only for body-origin external calls; never alone drives lane/severity (primary_controller.py:161 and company_overview.py:940 already treat it as non-semantic; lane.js/meta.js follow).
POLICY-SITE CLAIMS (replace cross_contract.py propagate-all): typed derivations only — (1) value-flow propagation: caller's sink selector ∈ asset/mint/burn family AND callee address resolved via controller_values AND callee's own claim is selector-tier (no control-plane label ever propagates — ends the Teller.deposit hook_update contagion and the updateExchangeRate deployment nondeterminism); (2) configures_transfer_policy_of(target) (NEW): this contract's written set-vars are read by its hook function AND a sibling's hook-pointer controller_value == this contract (Teller→BoringVault, all artifacts verified present at policy time); (3) provenance upgrades: implementation_update selector-tier → proxy-verified tier when the classifier confirms the 1967 slot on the linked proxy.

CONSUMER MIGRATION (conceptual): vocabulary is unchanged plus 3 additions (authorized_caller_update, proxy_admin_update, configures_transfer_policy_of) and 2 resurrections; effect_labels stays readable as string list (tier/witness ride alongside), so lane.js/meta.js/protocolScore.js/principal_enrichment.py work unmodified on day one; then: CONTROL_EFFECTS += the new labels; principal_enrichment admin set: hook_update out (measured zero prod dependency), authorized_caller_update + proxy_admin_update in; compactActionSummary sentences follow the registry's claim sentences; tier optionally weights severity.

irreducible_ceilings: OZ v5 namespaced storage + Solady assembly owner writes: Slither cannot attribute which slot a $.member write hits (verified: L1SyncPoolETH writes 'OwnableStorageLocation' from every touching fn; TopUp writes nothing). Design response: canonical selector+event tier carries the standard functions (transferOwnership/renounceOwnership/upgradeTo…); NON-canonical writers on such contracts stay SILENT (fact-text), never guessed. OZ v5 initialize's owner-set is knowingly unlabeled.

Caller-keyed data map vs ACL membership (LayerZero composeQueue vs wards): structurally identical leaves (documented at effects.py:436-443, confirmed on real EndpointV2). Design response: role/ACL-membership claims stay selector-canonical; membership-map writers get NO role claim (Maker rely/deny = fact-text; a Maker-wards selector pack is possible future selector-tier work, not a guess).

Whole-contract behavioral semantics (H3 packs): 'this approve behaves exactly like OZ ERC20.approve' is statically unverifiable on forks (5/8 measured ERC20 matches deviate). Design response: never emit pack-level claims; only mechanism-level claims with witnesses.

Whether an upgrade function controls a LIVE proxy: static sees the impl only. Design response: static emits selector+marker tier; the policy tier upgrades provenance when the classifier confirms the linked proxy slot — the claim text never exceeds its tier.

Intent/severity semantics (is this pause benign ops or rug vector; is a config uint economically critical): not derivable from code. Design response: silence — severity stays a consumer-side policy over claims + capability + principals.
Business-effect of arbitrary bytes paths (manage/execute payloads): only the arbitrariness is provable (taint), never the payload's meaning. Marked as arbitrary_external_call, nothing more.

Guard-extraction-uncertain functions (predicate pipeline fails closed): no tree ⇒ no tree-tier claims possible; such functions can carry only selector/fact tiers (consistent with the existing unsupported/fail-closed policy rows).
anti_heuristic_guardrails: Registry-as-schema: labels are constructible only via emit_claim(claim_id, tier, witness) where the registry (a typed Python module, imported by both producer sites) defines each claim's sentence, allowed tiers, and witness schema; EffectiveFunction.effect_labels' successor column stores {label, tier, witness} and the schema has NO tier value for 'heuristic/guess' — an unevidenced label is unrepresentable, not just discouraged. (The current system's guess tier lives at exactly one line, summaries.py:727 — the redesign makes that line untypeable.)

Frozen-corpus A/B diff gate in CI: the 21 real contracts from this investigation (WETH9, EETH, BoringVault, Teller, Accountant, RolesAuthority, L1SyncPoolETH, EndpointV2, FiatTokenProxy, FiatTokenV2_2, DAI, Comp, EtherFiTimelock, OneSig, TopUp, EtherFiNodesManager, StakedTokenV1, BackingEigen, LiquidityPool, StrategyManager proxy+impl) become checked-in compilation fixtures; CI recomputes all (contract, selector, label, tier) tuples and fails unless the PR includes the reviewed golden diff — every label-behavior change is visible and attributable, no silent drift.

New-label admission rule enforced by the same gate: adding a registry entry requires ≥3 fixture cases — one positive, one negative, one adversarial near-miss (e.g. pause: Teller require-pause positive, initialize negative, OneSig config-toggle near-miss) — the pattern that would have caught every one of the 16 defect classes measured here.

Witness replay tests: for each tier a generic test re-verifies emissions on the fixture corpus (tree-tier: the referenced leaf exists and has the required role/kind/operand types; selector-tier: selector matches and the corroborating event/marker is present; taint-tier: the sink's destination/data trace to parameters) — a detector that drifts from its evidence spec fails without anyone writing a new test.

Single vocabulary module per side: consumers import label→{lane, tone, sentence, severity-kind, tag-set} from one shared map (extending company_overview._EFFECT_CAPABILITY / meta.js), eliminating the measured N-place drift (5 consumer sites today) and the dead-label class (a consumer referencing an unregistered label fails lint).
evidenceFirst.migration_sketch: Non-binding, explicitly not a decision criterion. Phase 0: land facts-plane fixes behind the existing artifact schema (sink.origin, member writes, clobber fix, constant/view exclusion) — pure accuracy, no consumer change; add the fixture corpus + A/B gate pinned to CURRENT behavior. Phase 1: introduce the claim registry and re-home existing detectors under it (tree/selector/structural tiers), dual-writing legacy effect_labels strings for consumers; golden diff reviewed against this investigation's expected corrections (hook 340→~14+facts, pause −32FP/+7FN-recovered, impl 0→40+, ownership −47FP). Phase 2: consumers switch to tiered reads; principal_enrichment admin-set swap (hook_update→authorized_caller_update/proxy_admin_update); resurrect timelock_operation/arbitrary_external_call consumer branches (already wired). Phase 3: replace cross_contract.py propagate-all with the typed policy-site derivations; delete the fallback tier and legacy columns. Tests pinning the guess tier (test_contract_analysis.py:301) are rewritten to pin the registry behavior instead.
evidenceFirst.confidence: HIGH on the empirical core: every number comes from either exhaustive prod queries (2182 rows, label distributions, per-fn-name breakdowns) or local in-process runs of CURRENT main code on 21 real verified contracts (reproducing prod symptoms exactly where comparable: EETH/WETH9/StakedTokenV1 approve, L1 family ownership, initialize pause), and the H1 derivations were actually prototyped and re-run (v1→v2) with their own FPs found and fixed (payoutAddress, validatorSizeWei) — the design gates cited are the ones that survived measurement, not aspirations. HIGH on the consumer map (every decision site read in code). Genuine wins measured: Dai.wards = {mapping, gate_for_n_fns=3} → 'edits authorization mapping wards (gates 3 fns)' — correct where current says 'changes hook'; WrapToken pauser = {address, caller_eq_in_tree, gates 2} → 'rotates caller-authority address pauser' — the truth that ownership_transfer overclaims; paused = {bool, gates 12} → provable pause-gate fact. BUT the naive derivation FAILS measurably without role discrimination: reentrancy _status presents as 'gate var gating 4 fns' → redeemEEth/createBid/executeTransaction jump to CONTROL lane; Teller share-lock `locked` (gates 8) drags deposit into control; AccessControlStorageLocation ghost 'gates 18 fns'; the one real hook (BoringVault.hook) is LOST (callee-pointer role wasn't in my naive schema); Accountant pause invisible (struct granularity); SafeL2 owners/modules facts are empty (no modifier reads) → signer mgmt still weak; composeQueue PASS (facts stay silent about roles).
hypotheses.corpus_impact_numbers: derive_sim.py: 174/415 lane changes vs current; control lane 211→184 but with wrong composition (nonReentrant bloat in, real pause out); value lanes collapse in 32→4, out 60→13 when selector semantics are dropped — consumers are STARVED without a semantics layer.
hypotheses.consumer_fit: protocolScore/classifyAction and company_overview capability chips cannot rank 'writes tierData' vs 'writes wards' without re-inventing semantics per consumer — H2 alone relocates the guessing into N consumers (worse creep surface). principal_enrichment _admin from raw facts = the same reentrancy/business-gate FPs measured above.
hypotheses.failure_modes: 1) Facts inherit Slither granularity bugs (ghost constants look like gate vars: OwnableStorageLocation gate_for=10 caller_eq=True) — needs builder-level hygiene. 2) Role facts must come from the predicate-tree role taxonomy (authority_role ∈ caller_authority/pause/reentrancy/business/time/one_shot), not raw modifier reads — my measured FPs all violate this. 3) Engine variance: LZTeller pause()/EndpointV2.sendCompose report writes=[] (1-2/27 contracts) — any fact consumer inherits it.
hypotheses.verdict: ADOPT AS LAYER 0 (the substrate), NOT as the whole design. Facts-only starves consumers (measured); facts + role-taxonomy + standards layer does not.

irreducible_ceilings: 1. Cross-contract hook semantics: whether Teller.allowFrom's fromDenyList edit changes TRANSFER behavior is decided by BoringVault's beforeTransfer call into the Teller — invisible to single-contract static analysis. Design response: facts state 'edits mapping fromDenyList'; the policy-stage cross-contract pass (which sees both artifacts) may upgrade to a denylist claim; never claimed statically. (The merged cofinite/denylist work already models the downstream half.)

2. Struct-field write granularity: Slither reports var-level writes, so AccountantWithRateProviders.pause() writing accountantState.isPaused is indistinguishable from updatePlatformFee() writing accountantState.platformFee. Pause semantics there are unprovable at current engine granularity. Design response: silence + fact 'writes accountantState (struct)'; registry entry only if field-sensitive analysis lands. Same root cause as the OZ v5 namespaced-storage ghost writes (storage-pointer binding reported as a write of the location constant — source-verified mechanism).

3. Caller-keyed mapping purpose: a caller-keyed data map (LayerZero composeQueue) is structurally identical to a caller-keyed ACL membership map — role-management semantics are never derivable from write shape (the repo's own counterexample, effects.py:436-443, now institutionalized as a mandatory counterexample fixture class). Design response: permanent silence from shape; only selector/standard evidence may claim role management.

4. Business meaning of unmatched config writes (setMerkleRoot, updateTier, rebase, EndpointV2 library config): no checkable evidence source exists for 'what this parameter means'. Design response: fact text + function name (exactly what company_overview.py:940-942 already chose for this class).

5. Assembly-slot writes without a standard anchor (WrapTokenV3ETH.updateEthReceiver -> assembly_storage:position): sinks record the write but the slot's meaning is unprovable; the existing assembly_state_access fail-closed flag (effects.py:75-81) is the right response and is preserved.

6. Beneficiary/direction of value flows: depositIntoStrategy 'sends' tokens via transferFrom on behalf of the caller — mechanism (transferFrom, target) is provable, who ultimately benefits is not. Claims state mechanism only.

7. Analysis-engine variance: two of 27 contracts yielded empty write-sets for functions that plainly write storage (LayerZeroTeller.pause(), EndpointV2.sendCompose — measured, cause not fully diagnosed). Any design consuming Slither facts inherits this floor; mitigation is multi-source corroboration (pause pass + predicate leaves + writes), not certainty.

8. Solady/assembly-slot authority writes: transferOwnership writing _OWNER_SLOT via sstore is invisible as a var write; only the standards layer (selector family) can claim it — a contract using Solady-style assembly auth with RENAMED selectors is unlabelable statically (falls to facts + the existing unsupported/fail-closed policy row).

novel_hypotheses.summary: Layer 0: verifiable facts artifact (H2's substrate, hardened by measured hygiene rules + predicate-role sourcing). Layer 1: a closed registry of standard/idiom matchers emitting claims-objects {claim_id, evidence, tier ∈ {standard_exact, idiom_structural}} — H3's mechanics under a schema-enforced registry contract. No fallback tier exists in the type system. Consumers read claims first, facts second; UI words become a renderer-side map keyed by claim_id.
novel_hypotheses.evidence_standard: Every semantic statement is either a fact (directly checkable against IR) or a claim whose registry entry carries a written claim text + machine-checkable gate predicates + positive AND counterexample fixtures on real contracts + an approved corpus label-diff. Nothing emittable is unfalsifiable; the 'guess' provenance does not exist as a type.
novel_hypotheses.hard_case_results: Union of measured H2+H3 results: composeQueue PASS (silence by construction + mandatory counterexample fixture); ERC-20/WETH9 PASS; UUPS/zos PASS (17 impl-update claims vs 0 today); Timelock PASS (6); Safe PASS (12); Maker wards PASS; Solady ownership PASS; OZ v5 ownership PASS ghost-immune; Comp delegation PASS; pause PASS for OZ/isPaused idioms + honest residue for EigenLayer-registry family; Accountant struct family = honest facts (nothing lies; semantics unprovable at var granularity — named ceiling); beforeTransfer denylist = facts statically + policy-stage cross-contract upgrade path.
novel_hypotheses.consumer_fit: Demonstrated against consumer code: lane.js gets claims.control_plane->top, flow facts->left/right (derive_sim.py pathologies fixed by hygiene+role sourcing); protocolScore gets evidence-backed upgrade/admin/exec families replacing its name-substring arm (protocolScore.js:167) and its dead-label arms (:170,:177); principal_enrichment maps claim families to _admin/_operator/_manager (the _manager tag becomes producible); primary_controller PRIVILEGED set maps 1:1 to claim families; company_overview capability chips key off claim_id (its deliberate hook/external exclusion is preserved — facts-only fns show names, as it already chose); monitoring enrollment upgrades is_pausable recall via pause claims (Teller case measured).
novel_hypotheses.failure_modes: Coverage honesty: 37% exact-semantic coverage measured in-sample; consumers see neutral fact text for the rest — if product later demands semantic words everywhere, pressure lands on the registry gate (the design's whole point is that this pressure becomes visible PRs with fixtures instead of silent regex edits). Registry maintenance cost is real and permanent.
novel_hypotheses.verdict: RECOMMEND. It is the only evaluated configuration with zero measured wrong claims on the 27-contract corpus, recovers the highest-value missing semantics (upgrades/timelock/Safe), and has a structural (schema+CI) anti-creep story.

novel_hypotheses.summary: LLM proposes semantic labels for the facts residue; a fact-checker only admits labels consistent with facts.
novel_hypotheses.evidence_standard: Fails the mission constraint: the admitted statement's truth still rests on model judgment wherever facts underdetermine semantics (which is precisely the residue it would be used on — e.g. 'writes accountantState' cannot verify 'pauses the vault'). The checker can only verify what facts already prove, at which point the LLM adds nothing but nondeterminism.
novel_hypotheses.hard_case_results: Not run (would require prompt-engineering a judge; by construction it cannot beat the fact-checker's own ceiling). Accountant pause: facts cannot confirm or refute an LLM 'pause' proposal — the exact case it would be wanted for is the case it cannot be verified in.
novel_hypotheses.consumer_fit: Chips would regain words at the cost of unfalsifiable provenance; protocolScore severities would ride model output.
novel_hypotheses.failure_modes: Nondeterministic corpus diffs break the A/B gate; per-run label flapping; audit trail is a model transcript, not a checkable predicate.
novel_hypotheses.verdict: REJECT as a claim producer. Acceptable offline as a registry-authoring assistant (suggesting new idiom entries for humans to fixture and gate).

novel_hypotheses.evidence_standard: Perfect (only resolver output + sink facts), but vacuous where it matters.

cleanSlate.recommended_design:
WINNER: H5 — a two-layer claims-registry design (facts substrate + gated standards/idiom claims), assembled from the measured-good parts of H2 and H3, with H4's existing policy-stage cross-contract pass retained for claims that need callee identity, and H1's two proven components (guess-tier deletion, selector canonicalization) subsumed.

WHAT A LABEL *IS*: there are exactly two kinds of emitted statement, and both are objects, not strings. (K1) FACT — a record checkable directly against Slither IR by a deterministic predicate: state-write {var, declared_type, granularity: var|namespaced_struct|assembly_slot, hygiene_class: normal|constant|storage_location_pseudo|reentrancy_guard}, var-role {gate-bool-for-N-state-changing-fns via predicate-leaf role='pause', caller-authority-equality via leaf role='caller_authority' (operand var named — so 'rotates caller-authority address `pauser`' renders instead of a fake 'ownership transfer'), callee-pointer-invoked-by-sibling-entry (the measured-clean _writes_hook_reference signal), fallback-delegatecall-read, one_shot latch via one_shot leaves}, value-flow {low-level value call, Transfer IR (.transfer()/.send() — fixes the WETH9.withdraw miss), callee ERC-20 selector}, sink {kind, target, selector, origin: body|modifier} (origin fixes the Teller.pause requiresAuth pollution). Facts are produced by build_effects hardened with builder-level hygiene: constants, *StorageLocation/*_SLOT pseudo-vars, and reentrancy-role vars can never appear as role facts (each exclusion measured necessary in derive_sim.py). (K2) CLAIM — {claim_id, tier ∈ {standard_exact, idiom_structural}, evidence: {gate_facts, trigger}} minted ONLY by a registry matcher whose entry carries: written claim text; a machine-checkable evidence spec = contract-level GATE (mandated sibling selectors, write-target identity, sink shape — e.g. uups := proxiableUUID() present; safe := getThreshold+getOwners+execTransaction; pausable := pause()+unpause()+({paused,isPaused,_paused} write identity or paused view); wards := rely+deny+wards write identity) plus a per-function trigger (canonical selector or fact-pattern); ≥1 positive real-contract fixture; ≥1 counterexample fixture (composeQueue-class); an approved corpus A/B diff. Initial registry = the 18 matchers measured in h3sim.py (erc20, weth, ownable/2step, solady_ownable, access_control, access_control_dar, pausable, oz_pausable_var, uups, proxy_shell, safe, oz_timelock, solmate_auth, solmate_roles, maker_wards, comp_votes, fiattoken, lz_oapp) + callee_pointer.rotate idiom + exec.arbitrary gates. Measured yield on the 27-contract corpus: 154 exact claims / 415 state-changing fns, 0 observed false claims, recovering implementation_update (17 vs 0 today), timelock ops (6 vs 0), Safe signer/module/guard semantics (12 vs 0/wrong), Solady + OZ v5 ownership (ghost-immune), Maker wards, Comp delegation. (K3) A thin POLICY-STAGE augmentation (existing cross_contract.py path, claims instead of labels) adds cross-contract claims that need callee identity: beacon upgrade (upgradeEtherFiNode), callee mint/burn propagation — computed downstream because the evidence lives downstream, per H4's one correct insight.

HOW EACH IS PRODUCED: facts in effects.py from IR + predicate-leaf roles (single source for role discrimination — the taxonomy that already exists at the leaf level: caller_authority/pause/reentrancy/business/time/one_shot); claims in a new registry module invoked after build_effects with (contract, facts, predicate_trees) — a pure function of source; policy augmentation in policy_worker as today. The deleted machinery: _writes_unclassified_address_pointer (+fallback :727), _is_address_like_state_var, _writes_owner_like_address, _writes_authority_reference, _detect_supply_change_pattern, the ownership post-pass as sole emitter (kept only as corroborating fact 'caller-authority var write'), _writes_pause_like_bool and pause_info as claim sources (both measured imprecise; they persist as fact inputs).

EVIDENCE STANDARDS (written, per statement kind): facts — the predicate over IR must evaluate true (test = re-run predicate); standard_exact claims — gate + trigger predicates over facts must evaluate true AND the standard's semantics are the claim's semantics by the standard's own documentation (test = fixtures); idiom_structural claims — same shape, for de-facto idioms (wards, callee-pointer, weth), always with counterexample fixtures. UNKNOWN = silence + fact text; the design chooses SILENCE over marked-guess, because the marked-guess variant was measured to be exactly today's hook_update (1/69) and the consumers that matter already treat coarse labels as noise (primary_controller.py:161-164, company_overview.py:940-942).

CONSUMER MIGRATION (conceptual): lane.js — control lane := any control_plane claim OR control-role fact (gate-var write, callee-pointer rotate, fallback-slot write, creation/selfdestruct sink); left/right := flow facts/claims; chips := renderer map claim_id→existing vocabulary ('changes owner' stays as the TEXT for ownership.transfer — the UI words survive, their backing becomes checkable), fact-text otherwise; ordering := claim-family priority (same 0-9 shape). protocolScore.classifyAction := claim families (upgrade claims → 1.0 — replacing the name-substring arm; exec.arbitrary → 0.95 — producible for the first time; ownership/roles/authority/signer → 0.88; pause claims split pause/unpause honestly). principal_enrichment := _admin from control-claim families, _operator from flow claims, _manager from exec.arbitrary. primary_controller PRIVILEGED_EFFECT_LABELS := privileged claim families (same semantics, minus the dead entries). company_overview _EFFECT_CAPABILITY := claim_id→chip word.
